biotools.summary: ENCORI (Encyclopedia of RNA Interactomes) is a web-accessible database portal for searching AGO CLIP- and RBP CLIP-supported RNA interactions across mRNAs, lncRNAs, circRNAs, pseudogenes, small RNAs and caRNAs, with an API tutorial for programmatic access.
